then sinks again to its deepest depths,
leaving its gloomy mouth agape.
Then up again it wells, seething,
glowing, boiling fire,
while Great Pan looks on unperturbed,
enjoying the sight of this wonder
as pearls of foam spray out right and left.
How can he be so unsuspecting?
He’s stooping low to look down in.
But his beard falls off and plunges downward!
Whose beard was it?
And whose smooth-shaved chin?
His hand hides it so none can see.
Ah, but what a calamity now!
The beard aflame flies back up
and sets afire his wreath, his head,
his breast! All our pleasure
is turned to grief! Running toward him
to put out the blaze, not one of his throng
of followers escapes!
Even as they slap and beat at the flames,
new flames are fanned,
a new blaze begun! Engulfed in fire,
a group of maskers burns to death!
But what’s this I hear
spread by word of mouth from ear to ear?
O night, unhappy night,
cursed night,
what grief have you brought us!
Tomorrow will bring what no one wants to hear!
And I hear it shouted from every side:
“Tt was the Emperor who was burned!”
O God, if only it weren't true!
The Emperor burned and all those with him!
Curse them,
curse all those who misled him,
translation:
@@U02494@@
然后再次沉入最深处，
让它张开阴郁的嘴。
然后它又涌上来，沸腾，
炽热、沸腾的火焰，
而大潘看上去泰然自若，
欣赏这奇观
泡沫珍珠从左右喷出。
他怎么可以这么毫无戒心呢？
他弯下腰往下看。
但他的胡子却掉下来了，往下掉！
那是谁的胡子？
谁的下巴剃光了？
他的手遮住了它，这样别人就看不到了。
啊，但现在真是一场灾难啊！
胡须着火了又飞了起来
并点燃他的花环、他的头，
他的乳房！我们所有的荣幸
转为悲伤！跑向他
去扑灭大火，而不是他的一伙人
的追随者逃跑了！
即使他们拍打着火焰，
新的火焰正在被煽动，
新的火焰开始了！被大火吞噬，
一群蒙面人被烧死！
但我听到这是什么
通过口口相传传播？
噢，夜晚，不幸的夜晚，
被诅咒的夜晚，
你给我们带来了多大的悲伤！
明天将会带来没人想听到的事情！
我听到它从四面八方呼喊：
“被烧死的是皇帝！”
天哪，如果这不是真的就好了！
皇帝和所有跟随他的人都被烧死了！
诅咒他们，
诅咒所有误导他的人，
